question.shortAnswer: Разделить на routes (URL mapping), controllers (HTTP req/res), services (бизнес-логика), models (БД), middleware (auth, errors). `app.js` — setup без listen; `server.js` — только listen для тестов supertest. Routes тонкие; логику не в app.js.
question.idealAnswer: Layered structure: routes → controllers → services → models. routes/users.routes.js — URL + middleware only; controllers — status codes, JSON, delegate to service; services — business logic без HTTP; models — Mongoose/Prisma. app.js exports app без listen; server.js connectDB + listen — supertest imports app. middleware/: auth, rateLimiter, error (last). config/ validated env at startup. validators/ per resource. When: <10 routes flat ok; 10-50 add routes/controllers/models; 50+ full stack + routes/index.js. Errors: logic in routes; global authenticate blocks /health; no routes/index; controller calls Model directly; inline process.env. Testing: unit mock service in controller; integration supertest; Pact contracts. Senior monorepo: bounded context folders billing-domain/, eslint-plugin-import boundaries. Frameworks: NestJS, MedusaJS same layering.

falseClaims: вся логика в app.js — best practice для 50 routes
